_comment: Capability: calendar clash-catching. Dan forwards a party invite from the class group chat; Fred logs it AND catches that the family is away that weekend, then sets the RSVP reminder.

messages.text: Hi everyone! Jessie is having her birthday party at Adventure Zone on Saturday 11th October, 2–4pm. All the class welcome! Please RSVP by Wednesday so we can give numbers for food. Emma x

Invite logged — but heads up: you’re at your mum’s that weekend, back Sunday. Saturday 2pm doesn’t work.

Want a reminder to reply to Emma before Wednesday either way?
ah no. Ivy will be gutted. yes remind me tomorrow
Will do — 8pm tomorrow. And Ruby’s party on the 18th is still in the diary with nothing against it, so the month isn’t a total loss. 🎈
